entities.summary: Geledi Sultanate, a political institution in Somalia during Post-Ajuran Somali States (1700–1910). Grew from Majeerteen Sultanate and Ifat and Adal Sultanates. Led to the emergence of Ethiopian and Somali Clan Dynamics Pre-Colonial.
